description.value: Angry Otter Liquor is a retail liquor store operated by Otter Co-op, a locally-owned co-operative with locations across the Fraser Valley and beyond. The Clearbrook branch is one of several Angry Otter stores serving the Abbotsford region. Touring cyclists passing through the area could stop here to resupply on beverages.
